title: Stepful, an AI-powered online training platform for healthcare workers, raised a $55M Series C led by Oak HC/FT, bringing its total funding to $105M (Heather Landi/Fierce Healthcare)
summary: Heather Landi / Fierce Healthcare: Stepful, an AI-powered online training platform for healthcare workers, raised a $55M Series C led by Oak HC/FT, bringing its total funding to $105M — Oak HC/FT Medical Training staffing funding round — Healthcare staffing shortages are a near-universal problem for healthcare providers.
